comments.author: Almeida
comments.body: Get quest "Searching Further for a New World" at Marseilles Adventure Guild. Note: be sure to go to the landing area north of San Francisco first (part of the quest), as if you try and enter San Francisco first you will likely get the message that you do not yet know about this age (19th century). That becomes a moot point if you go to the landing area first.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To qualify for the SF unlock quest, you must:

1. Talk to Mercator in Amsterdam and chart the North Sea as part of the World Atlas side-quest
2. Unlock port permits up through East Asia
3. Talk to Mercator twice -- once to receive Northeast Passage permits, and a second time to receive West Coast of North America permit
4. The quest appears in Marseilles as Almeida states.

It's a 7* 19th Century Chrono quest. Quest Steps:

1. Talk to Justine x1 (Marseilles Tavern)
2. Talk to Justine x1 (Marseilles Merchant Guild)
3. North American West Coast - Talk to Justine x1 (near the entrance)
4. NA West Coast - Talk to Justine x1 (slightly north along the beautiful river)
5. NA West Coast - Talk to Justine or the odd man (on the other side of the river)
6. Sail south and dock in San Francisco. After a short cutscene, you automatically enter town and fully unlock it for the future.
7. San Francisco - Talk to Justine (near where you enter town)
8. San Francisco - Talk to Justine (right, towards the bank)

Quest complete. Consider taking a longsword or two from the Marseilles item shop to give to SF's barmaid as a gift to be able to report quest right there in town.

Recent patches have made it easier to gain this quest, it reportedly can show up with as little as 200 adventure fame. Hope that all helps -- cheers, and great frontier voyaging to you... pardners. *cough*
